label: SI-10(1)
title: Manual Override Capability

children.label: (a)
children.prose: Provide a manual override capability for input validation of the following information inputs: {{ insert: param, si-10_odp }};

children.label: (b)
children.prose: Restrict the use of the manual override capability to only {{ insert: param, si-10.01_odp }} ; and

children.label: (c)
children.prose: Audit the use of the manual override capability.

guidance: In certain situations, such as during events that are defined in contingency plans, a manual override capability for input validation may be needed. Manual overrides are used only in limited circumstances and with the inputs defined by the organization.

params.label: authorized individuals
guidelines: authorized individuals who can use the manual override capability are defined;
